messages:
maria: Quick async milestone check — Q3 OKR milestone for Connector work. What shipped, what slipped, owners + next steps. TL;DR: auth support + batch ingestion shipped; schema migration slipped; need CR attention on PR 423.

sam: Shipped: connector auth + batch ingest (canary -> prod). Logs look stable. PRs 419 and 420 merged. Thanks @ryan for the test vectors.

alex: Slipped: schema migration blocked by downstream contract changes from Payments. ETA +2 weeks unless we get a quick contract sync. I can pair with their Eng lead.

leah: Infra note: autoscale policy change for batch runners goes live tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Expect a brief warmup spike for new pods. Recommend a staged canary before full switch.

ryan: Product/QA: verified batch ingest happy path. Found edge case: newline-delimited payloads >4MB get dropped. Filed bug #553. Repro: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/ingest -d @large.ndjson
# observe 413 in logs
```

sam: @ryan saw the 413, that's nginx client_max_body_size. I'll raise it in canary and monitor. Will push change today. Anyone +1 on canary-first rollout? :thumbsup: 

maria: +1 to canary-first. Also owners for schema migration: alex + sam. Product acceptance: backward-compatible reads for 2 weeks and a migration flag to toggle.

alex: I'll sync with Payments and set up a joint sync. Sending calendar invite for Tue 10:00am PT.

/devops-bot/: deploy-notify: Canary for connector-auth-batch deployed at 2026-03-18T20:15:12Z — health OK, 1% traffic.

leah: Noted. I'll watch latency dashboards and alert if p50 > 300ms during canary.

sam: PR 423 (schema migration) needs two reviewers: @leah for infra impact, @ryan for acceptance tests. @maria can you confirm QA signoff criteria?

maria: QA signoff criteria: integration tests green on branch, migration flag respected, rollback path validated. After QA signoff we'll pick a low-traffic migration window and notify customers.

ryan: Can review PR 423 tomorrow morning. I'll push additional test vectors tonight.

alex: Thanks everyone. Quick next-steps summary:
- Sam: update nginx `client_max_body_size` in canary + monitor (today)
- Alex: payments contract sync (Tue 10:00am PT)
- Leah: monitor dashboards + autoscale switch (tomorrow 06:00 UTC)
- Ryan: review PR 423 + push tests (tomorrow)
- Maria: coordinate migration window + customer comms after QA signoff

maria: Leaving this thread open for updates — please ping here once PRs land or if blockers pop up. :eyes:
